verdict.rationale: Morph is an inference API platform, so serving custom weights is a fair question. However, the evidence shows no way to upload your own model weights or LoRA adapters. Dedicated endpoints let you reserve capacity for a model Morph provisions and operates. Custom Reflexes train small text classifiers from labeled examples. Neither is uploading or serving user-supplied weights or adapters.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can upload and serve my own custom model weights or LoRA adapters
